### The Potter and the Clay
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/the-potter-and-the-clay
Passage: Isaiah 64:8
Points:
- An artisan potter demonstrates meticulous care, attention, and patience while molding clay on the wheel.
- When an imperfection appears, the potter gently reshapes and reworks the material into something even better.
- God deals with His people like clay in the Potter's hands, continuously fashioning our character.
- The Lord possesses the authority to reshape, hollow out, and refine us according to His sovereign plan.
- Believers can take comfort in knowing they are the personal objects of God's focused care and affection.

### How Prayer Glorifies God
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/how-prayer-glorifies-god
Passage: Isaiah 64:4
Points:
- God displays His unique divine greatness not by demanding service from needy people, but by acting on their behalf.
- Scripture shows that God is self-sufficient and never posts a help-wanted sign for humanity.
- True prayer glorifies God by bringing our burdens to Him rather than treating Him as though He needs our help.
- Waiting for the Lord means turning first to Him in prayer instead of relying on human alternatives.
- Believers can face impossible trials with boldness, knowing God promises to work for those who wait on Him.
